name: lx_dsh_peek
description: Read-only, no-input, light-themed LAN peek at active DSH sessions, plus host-injected font and conversation-width overrides for the official DSH UI (no patched DMG). Live reasoning, background-command output, animated running state, tail-only panes with hidden scrollbars, one multiplexed SSE, live turn/end dismissal, 1/2/3/4 panes and orientation-aware layout.
author: llp
